name: Sunrise Auto Repair
headline: Honest auto repair Miami has trusted for 25 years
tagline: Family-owned service on brakes, AC, engines and more — with upfront pricing and no surprises.
why_head: The shop your neighbors actually recommend
about: We're a family-owned shop that treats your car like our own. No upsells, no runaround — just honest work from ASE-certified techs who've kept Miami running for 25 years.

services.name: Brakes & Rotors
services.desc: Squeaking or grinding? We'll inspect and fix it fast, with quality parts that last.

services.name: Oil & Maintenance
services.desc: Fast oil changes and full tune-ups to keep your car running smooth for years.

services.name: AC Repair
services.desc: Miami heat is no joke. We get your A/C blowing cold again, same day when possible.

services.name: Engine Diagnostics
services.desc: Check-engine light on? We pinpoint the real problem — no guessing, no upsells.

services.name: Tires & Alignment
services.desc: New tires, rotations, and precision alignments to keep you safe on the road.

services.name: Transmission
services.desc: From fluid service to full repairs, we keep your transmission shifting right.

reviews.text: Been coming here for years. They're honest, fast, and never try to sell you stuff you don't need. Rare to find these days.
reviews.author: Maria G.

reviews.text: My AC died in July and they had it fixed the same afternoon for a fair price. Lifesavers.
reviews.author: Andre T.

reviews.text: Took my truck in for brakes, they showed me exactly what was worn and only charged for what I needed. Trustworthy shop.
reviews.author: Luis R.
